notes: needs_ruling: the report carries two sayings with their own isnads: the brothers' judgment, narrated by Ibn Buraida (written above), and the Prophet's «الإسلام يزيد ولا ينقص» through «وقال حدثني أبو الأسود أن رجلا حدثه أن معاذا» (not written, since it is a different saying and not a route of this one)
the second isnad's unnamed «رجلا» would be an unnamed link and «معاذا» the Companion, if the owner rules it a separate route
Yahya ibn Ya'mar judges in the scene; he is not a link
